data.current_summary: Subscribe to Certified Live: charge one 30-day period ($9.00, 18,000 credits) and turn renewal on
data.current_description: Subscribes to Certified Live: charges one 30-day period of $9.00 (18,000 credits) and turns renewal on. API key only. Needs a verified domain for your deal route (409 certification_domain_unverified), an account funded with real money at least once (409 certification_unfunded) and a passing free test on your current route within 24 hours (409 certification_test_required). The fee, the paid period and its certification_fee journal entry are written in one transaction; a balance that does not cover the fee is 402 insufficient_funds_self and writes nothing. A period that is paid and renewing is 409 certification_already_active. An inactive account (its key disabled) is 403 api_key_disabled. A canceled period that is still paid is resumed free. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original result and never charges twice. Nothing is refunded: the fee buys the checks, not the badge.

Charges and journal entry are atomic; insufficient balance returns 402 insufficient_funds_self. Idempotency-Key prevents duplicate charges on replay. Canceled but paid periods resume free. Returns 409 if already active, domain unverified, account unfunded, or test required. Returns 403 if API key disabled. No refunds issued.
